subject: Kickoff: dictionary learning for embedding-table compression
body:
Team,

Kicking off a small but high-leverage track: embedding-table compression via the dictionary learning implementation from our open-source release. The method factors an embedding table into a dictionary (row_percentage controls how many dictionary words we keep) and a sparse code (col_percentage controls nonzeros per row). The reference example recovers a synthetic matrix at about 11% relative error with row_percentage=0.5 and col_percentage=0.3 -- if we can hold error in that range on the production retrieval tables, serving memory drops by more than half.

Goal for the half: a validated compression recipe for the two largest retrieval embedding tables, plus a serving integration plan, feeding the Q3 serving-cost OKR.

Jelena to propose staffing and the sweep plan.

Anders
